rightsRule: Use The Edinburg Advocate candidate announcement pages to corroborate candidate identity, office, campaign-controlled statements, and discover candidate-linked image assets. The site is All Rights Reserved, so do not approve or reuse any hosted image without item-level evidence that the image itself was candidate-supplied, a reusable license, explicit permission, or another documented editorial permission basis. Reject campaign graphics, logos, social-share art, and other non-portrait assets even when candidate-specific.

notes: New source discovered September 1, 2026 while researching missing HD40 candidate Celeste Cabrera-Huff.
